episodeTitle.en: Geoffrey Moore on finding your beachhead, crossing the chasm, and dominating a market
episodeTitle.zh: 杰夫瑞·摩尔谈如何找到突破口、跨越鸿沟、主导市场

guestBioOfficial.en: Geoffrey Moore is an author, speaker, and advisor, widely known for his seminal book Crossing the Chasm: Marketing and Selling Disruptive Products to Mainstream Customers, which many consider the most important book ever written on go-to-market strategy. Moore’s work is focused on the market dynamics surrounding disruptive innovations, and how one overcomes the challenge of transitioning from serving early adopters to the mainstream. In this episode, we discuss: • What “crossing the chasm” means
guestBioOfficial.zh: 杰夫瑞·摩尔是一位作家、演讲家和顾问，因其开创性的著作《跨越鸿沟：向主流客户销售颠覆性产品》而闻名，该书被许多人视为有史以来关于市场进入策略最重要的著作。摩尔的研究聚焦于围绕颠覆性创新的市场动态，以及如何克服从服务早期采用者到主流市场的挑战。在本期节目中，我们将探讨：• “跨越鸿沟”意味着什么

title.en: Geoffrey Moore on finding your beachhead, crossing the chasm, and dominating a market
title.zh: 杰夫瑞·摩尔谈如何找到突破口、跨越鸿沟、主导市场

summary.en: Geoffrey uses the 'kindling vs. log' metaphor to explain why, when stuck in the chasm, taking any customer you can find is a mistake—you need to light a fire in one narrow place first. He lays out the bowling-pin strategy for getting past early adopters, the specific go-to-market playbook for each stage of the adoption lifecycle, and the seven deadly sins of crossing the chasm incorrectly. The conversation also covers how to sell to different personas (and why early adopters don't need you to focus on problem and pain) plus some unexpected life advice.
summary.zh: Geoffrey 用“引火物 vs. 原木”的比喻说明：当卡在鸿沟（chasm）中时，来者不拒地抓客户是错的——你需要先在一个狭窄的点上把火点着。他讲解了用“保龄球瓶”策略越过早期采用者、针对不同采用生命周期阶段的特定上市打法，以及跨越鸿沟时最常见的七宗罪。对话还涵盖了如何向不同人物角色销售（以及为何对早期采用者无需执着于“问题”和“痛点”），并附带一些出乎意料的人生建议。
